baseline: unchanged v133, no v42/v44 rejected candidate
primary_universe: same 1602 v44 single-cluster matching-covariance decision times; unavailable candidate covariance fails coverage

scale_fit.gt: offline calibration only, authorized s2v45 and supervisor 06:05; no live GT
scale_fit.group: own commanded servo3,4,5,6 + inferred loaded profile + forward speed and duration; positive forward only
scale_fit.exclude: overlapping next nonzero drive before profile horizon; arm command during horizon; recorded wall contact during horizon (calibration only)
scale_fit.unmeasured: unchanged v122; no transfer between postures/load/speed
scale_fit.correction: multiply forward mean_curve x and mean_delta x only; yaw/lateral means and all noise unchanged

tempering.method: Thrun et al. 2005 sections 6.3.4 and 6.7: joint measurement likelihood to power alpha
tempering.parameter_status: a priori half-information comparison, not a book default or a value fit to evaluation GT; no alpha sweep
tempering.fit_split: no learned observation parameters; training pair used for overconfidence diagnosis only; the same fixed exponent tested on each held-out run
tempering.scope: entire existing wall times landmark score; first scan included; no threshold, detection, association, motion or resampling change

audit: each measurement: ESS and XY/yaw covariance prior after prediction, posterior before resampling, after resampling and reported covariance; wall/landmark likelihood correlation across particles is overlap evidence, not proof of independent noise correlation
physical: only a condition passes all three held-out runs; then new seed registration and agent_lock/ugrp_session
host_error: ENOSPC is HOST_ERROR, not a physical failure
